name: Mito Health
long_description:
Mito Health is a U.S. service that lets individuals order more than 1,000 laboratory markers, panels, scans, and at-home kits without going through a traditional doctor’s visit. Members pay $9 per month to access every test at the company’s published cost, see itemized receipts with no hidden mark-ups, and receive priority turnaround on results. 

After answering an online questionnaire, users receive personalized test recommendations, can schedule a nearby draw at the lowest available price, and obtain clinician-reviewed action plans that cover sleep, supplements, exercise, and other lifestyle factors. The platform also allows members to upload past lab data, view longitudinal trends, and chat year-round with clinicians or AI health coaching through the built-in Mito Concierge.
one_liner: At-cost preventive health: Labs, Scans, Genetics, Supplements and Rx
